scope: P32 selected unopened indexed history first official read-only route; independent source and evidence review, not native or full-suite acceptance.
reviewMethod: Applicable code-review-excellence workflow. Read final source and integration diff, meaningful original failures, author final logs, strict wire and actual component/controller assertions; recompute input hashes. No tests, Cargo, App, official CLI, database or configuration actions executed by this reviewer.

source.backendPostTestDelta: Only acp_client/mod.rs declaration ordering for rustfmt; author registration-format-followup records it. Final source checkpoint is post-format, not a fabricated whole-repository before/after manifest.

fixedFindingsReviewed.issue: Expired capability and zero read coverage were incorrectly described as changed settings or no match.
fixedFindingsReviewed.resolution: Neutral expiry/selection wording; unread, confirmed no-text, true no-match and unconfirmed discovered matches are separate. Original three copy reds plus final real-wire two reds retained.

fixedFindingsReviewed.issue: Captured old callbacks could affect a successor request or revive an expired preparation owner.
fixedFindingsReviewed.resolution: check/cancel/dismiss require exact requestId; retired owner WeakSet and activeOwner identity fence prepare/start. Selected row objects and explicit scope govern ownership; unrelated index addition does not retire unchanged selection. Old handlers and old prepare have actual component/controller red-to-green evidence.

fixedFindingsReviewed.issue: Current-row text was public before post-read source/Directory validation.
fixedFindingsReviewed.resolution: Read stages row hits privately through owned child/group/pipes cleanup; checks deadline/interest, original directory handle, complete original Agent/index metadata before publication. Cancellation and publication share Job value lock; earlier verified rows remain historical results.

fixedFindingsReviewed.issue: A reaped prior pendingCleanup state leaked into next-row reading.
fixedFindingsReviewed.resolution: Next row sets running/null under lock while interested; cancelled work cannot advance. Original controlled publication red retained, without claiming this case is an OS-unreapable process.

fixedFindingsReviewed.issue: Loaded same native id under another directory or proven entry alias could be treated as unopened.
fixedFindingsReviewed.resolution: Guard covers same Agent or exact known LaunchIdentity, then native id. It does not infer all-account identity or collide native IDs globally; actual controlled ACP alias red-to-green preserved.

fixedFindingsReviewed.issue: New post-read staging legitimately reports matchedTextBlocks>0 with no confirmed hits, which old UI called zero matches.
fixedFindingsReviewed.resolution: Actual final Rust readingUnconfirmed to sourceDrift chain is strictly parsed and rendered; UI labels viewable blocks and discovered-but-unconfirmed matches, and exposes no hit actions. Final real controller retains zero public hits.

mechanismsReviewed: Only supplied saved-index IDs are resolved by backend; exact AgentRow and SessionRow metadata, ticket and query identities are rechecked. No FE-supplied native id/cwd/command authority.

Fixed initialize/initialized/thread-read metadata/thread-turns-list full pages; no resume, prompt, model/reasoning setter or private history-file reader added. AccountScope and shared two-worker admission remain held through real cleanup.

Request tombstones, 4096 saturation, conflict rejection, live-release refusal and monotonic revisions keep late IPC from recreating authority. Status is observation, cancellation is a request until actual settled state.

Hit and context bodies stay RAM-only, plain React text; close/scope/Agent/query/selection changes discard display authority. Explicit existing protected open route is separate from preview and does not fabricate a turn jump.

20 selected rows, 20 pages per row, 10 turns per page, child stdout and total deadline bounds; partial/failure coverage remains visible. Original UTF16 offsets, lowercase literal matching and separate user text parts are preserved.

Same common UI is capability-driven; first route is macOS reviewed entry only. Official startup may maintain its state, and legacy pagination may replay full rollout internally; no zero-write/network or constant internal-cost guarantee.

wire.breakdown: 12 strict actual values + 2 actual Results SSR assertions + 1 actual-value controller chain. Available capability in controller setup is explicitly synthetic; unavailable capability is the actual Rust sample.

authorValidationReviewed.independentCommandsExecuted: hash/JSON/source inspection only; no rerun or new process experiment

referenceAudit.historicalBoundary: Prior FE checkpoint remains historical; its three changed files are not claimed equal to the final tree. Original raw failures and old actual-wire remain unchanged.

notEstablished: Full App browser acceptance (separate author/root work)

remaining: Parent may proceed with separate integration/browser/candidate gates. This review does not mark all P32 conditions complete.
